summary.en: A seam opens beside the exhibit and a ruled worksheet slides out of it; the struck figure lifts off the page as a paper slip, is set in code and laid on the worksheet; the title and rows follow.
summary.zh: 证物旁边切开一道缝，一张格子演算纸从缝里滑出来；被划出的数字作为纸条从页面上揭起，换成代码排的字，放到演算纸上；随后是标题和各行。

fits: A figure the page prints that the film needs to compute with.
notFor: figures to restate only; a second carry in one film.

intent.en: Show the arithmetic in the open: the figure is taken from the page itself, so the result can be checked.
intent.zh: 把计算摊开给人看：数字直接从页面上取下来，结果因此可核对。

content.en: The printed figure's box and ink box, its text, a title (≤ 16 chars) and 1–5 rows of label and value.
content.zh: 印出数字的框和墨迹框、它的文字，一个标题（≤ 7 字）和 1–5 行名称与数值。

fits.zh: 页面印着、片子要拿来计算的数字。

notFor.zh: 只需复述的数字；一部片里第二次搬运。

en: One carry a film; the slip never scales past 1.2× the sheet's scale while it is the page's pixels.
The title shares its line with the tab: keep it short.
zh: 一部片只搬运一次；纸条还是页面像素时，放大不超过页面比例的 1.2 倍。
标题和标签同一行：要短。

source.path: the dossier source film planOf worksheet; film.js buildWorksheet, paintWorksheet, buildSlip, slipAt, paintSlip, openParams

overlaps.note: runtime: a value carried between two contents; here the page's own pixels lift and become a code-set slip on paper
